title: Earthy Polish Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew that combines the earthy flavors of vegetables with the richness of polish sausage. Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced polish sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms, earthy broth, and sliced polish sausage back into the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the velvety cream and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
